record.title: Reconcile APK reader results against the existing physical observation authority
record.intent: Decide whether a new bounded physical cached observation is justified by the control evidence.
requirements: Evaluate method, hashes, permissions and synthetic values separately. A native mapping fixture is not stock initialization or physical permission evidence.

If justified draft a fresh bounded physical task under existing on-scope read authority, with current backing APK hash, stable setup and fresh isolated capture. No physical retries or mutations occur in this decision itself.
On failure branch offline and preserve the exact result. Commit and push decision and any successor tasking before execution.
acceptance: Evidence selects one bounded continuation without broadening physical authority.
